title: Expected Performance and Stability
summary: This topic centers on expected versus observed vehicle behavior, with clear praise for ride comfort and stability but many fragments too brief or context-limited to assign a firm sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the car as better than expected overall or highlight a strong balance of ride comfort, performance, and stability.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention stability, expected behavior, ongoing support, battery depletion, and feature expectations, but the examples are often too brief or incomplete to support a clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are labeled undetermined and several are too short or incomplete to identify a specific evaluative stance.

The cluster mixes multiple subjects, including ride stability, comfort, battery depletion, software expectations, support follow-up, and feature expectations, so it is not fully coherent as a single issue.
Examples are limited, so the available evidence is insufficient to describe finer-grained patterns beyond the supplied fragments.
